svg.title: Dual Claude Max + Device Fleet Hub workflow diagram
svg.desc: 6 steps. 1. Pick best models first (human, human gate). 2. Bridge to Codex CU (agent). 3. Drive device fleet (agent). 4. Run parallel agent tabs (agent). 5. Loop feedback to Notion (agent, human gate). 6. Distill weekly Waza (agent, human gate). Tools: claude-code, codex, skills, mcp, other.
